title: Persistence of preconnected fibres of a pointed clopen piece
statement: Let $g:P\to T$ be a finite type morphism of schemes (locally of finite type and quasi-compact, as in [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]), with a section $\sigma:T\to P$ satisfying $g\circ\sigma=\operatorname{id}_T$. Let $y\in T$, let $V\subseteq T$ be open with $y\in V$, and let $A\subseteq P$ have clopen trace on $g^{-1}(V\cap\overline{\{y\}})$ in the subspace topology. Assume that $g^{-1}(\{y\})\cap A$ is preconnected and $\sigma(y)\in A$. Then there is an ambient open $W\subseteq T$ with $y\in W\subseteq V$ such that $g^{-1}(\{t\})\cap A$ is preconnected for every $t\in W\cap\overline{\{y\}}$. No equality with a section component is asserted, and no claim is made about fibres outside this closure.

proof.text: base change to the reduced closed subscheme on the closure of y, and restrict the base to V. The displayed clopen subset determines an open and closed subscheme. Its inclusion is quasi-compact because its trace in every quasi-compact open is closed and hence quasi-compact. Thus its morphism to the restricted integral base is finite type. Its generic fibre is preconnected and contains the rational point supplied by sigma, so it is nonempty and connected. The section at the generic point factors through this open subscheme. Tag 04KV makes this generic fibre geometrically connected. Tag 055G gives a nonempty open of the integral base on which all its fibres are geometrically connected. Such an open contains y. Represent it by an ambient open W and intersect W with V to ensure W is a subset of V. The closed-base-change and fibre homeomorphisms identify each fibre with the set g inverse image {t} intersect A. Geometric connectedness implies its topological preconnectedness. Empty fibres are allowed by the conclusion, and no assertion is made outside the closure of y.

theorem exists_open_preconnected_fibres_of_pointed_clopen {P T : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : P ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (σ : T ⟶ P) (hσ : σ ≫ g = 𝟙 T) (y : T) (V : Set T) (A : Set P)
    (hV : IsOpen V) (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (hA : IsClopen {q : g ⁻¹' (V ∩ closure {y}) | (q : P) ∈ A})
    (hconn : IsPreconnected (g ⁻¹' {y} ∩ A)) (hpoint : σ y ∈ A) :
    ∃ W : Set T, IsOpen W ∧ y ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ V ∧
      ∀ t ∈ W ∩ closure {y}, IsPreconnected (g ⁻¹' {t} ∩ A)
